ready_message: Ready. Load an audio file. Press F1 for help.
ffmpeg_not_found: ⚠️ FFmpeg not found. Preview will work, but not final export.
generating_ffmpeg: ⏳ FFmpeg generation in progress on the entire file ({duration})... This may take time. Please be patient.
specify_files_error: Please specify input and output files.
ffmpeg_required: FFmpeg is required for final generation.

help_messages.size: Resolution of the final FFmpeg image (e.g., 1920x1080).
help_messages.mode: 'combined' overlays all channels. 'separate' displays them individually.
help_messages.color: Color palette. 'fiery' or 'magma' are excellent for song contrast.
help_messages.scale: 'log' (decibels) is highly recommended for the wide dynamic range of birds.
help_messages.fscale: 'log' allows seeing both low (owl) and high (kinglet) frequencies.
help_messages.win_func: Reduces spectral leakage. 'hann' or 'blackman' better isolate harmonics.
help_messages.gain: Signal amplification. Useful for very weak recordings.
help_messages.start: Minimum frequency to display (0 = auto). E.g., 1000 to ignore wind.
help_messages.stop: Maximum frequency to display (0 = auto). E.g., 12000 for passerines.
help_messages.drange: Dynamic range in dB. A high value (150) reveals weak songs.
help_messages.preview_duration: Preview duration in seconds (5 to 600). High values (>120s) consume a lot of RAM and are not recommended. FFmpeg export always processes the full file.
